paper_id: Chen et al. - 2009 - Difficulty-Aware Hybrid Search in Peer-to-Peer Networks
title: Difficulty-Aware Hybrid Search in Peer-to-Peer Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 混合P2P搜索需估计能回答查询的对等点数量,但现有方法假设项数多=peer多不成立
problem_framing: 如何区分与查询相关的项是分布在多个peer还是集中在少数peer,以选择 flooding 或 DHT
key_insight: Many items ≠ Many peers, 因兴趣局部性, 项可集中在少数peer, 需按查询难度选择搜索策略
method_signature: QRank: apTF×IPF 词项加权 + SVM 分类器选择 flooding/DHT 策略
evaluation_criteria: 召回率、延迟、流量成本、搜索效率和综合效用函数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: GAB 无法区分项分布在多peer还是少peer, 且选择合适Rmax阈值在不同系统规模下困难
evidence_for_taste: many items does not always mean flooding is more efficient
terms highly replicated in few peers are difficult ones
a verbose descriptive query can provide an indication of term importance
the same Rmax value may not work in different systems
thinking_moves: 从工程异常反推底层假设失效: GAB假设项数多→peer多, 但兴趣局部性使该假设不成立
重新定义问题形式化: 从估计项数量转变为估计查询难度分布
用SVM学习不同查询类型的策略选择模式
